name: openseo
description: SiDJI SEO personal fork: keyword and competitor research, audits, rankings, AI visibility and connected Google data. Requires your own local instance and provider keys.

interface.longDescription: Personal self-hosted fork of OpenSEO. Use your own SiDJI SEO instance for SEO research, saved project context, audits and connected Google data. Provider usage is billed by your providers.
defaultPrompt: Research keywords for my site and shortlist the best opportunities.
Audit my site and give me a one-page report with a single next action.
Track my rankings for these keywords and summarize what changed.
Suggest prompts to track in AI answers for my business and show me the cost.
Which sources and competitors appear in my saved AI answers?
